scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "node scripts/wait-for-url-and-run.mjs http://localhost:3002/auth/me -- npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/web
